svg.text: Recall and precision by k for three attack sets, NSL-KDD paper split, mean of 3 seeds
Each column is one flow set: the attacks named in its title plus all 874 normal flows of each seed. Top row: recall, the share of those attacks the detector alerted.
Bottom row: precision, the share of the detector's alerts on that set that were attacks; a false alarm on a normal flow lowers it. Same y scale in every panel.
k = labeled examples per category in the prompt; "all" = the forests fitted on the whole pool.
Recall (share of the panel's attacks that were alerted)
Precision (share of alerts that were attacks)
